title: Multiple pure core functions lack property-based tests: isSubscriptionDataObject, isEventDuplicate, isSubscriptionCreatedEvent, shouldSyncRole, isStatusUnknown
description: The purity boundary map lists 27 pure functions (verification-architecture.md lines 15-43), but only 15 have PROP-SYNC entries (PROP-SYNC-001 through PROP-SYNC-015). The following pure core functions have no property tests: isSubscriptionDataObject, isEventDuplicate, isSubscriptionCreatedEvent, shouldSyncRole, isStatusUnknown, buildTokenMismatchLog, buildCliResult, canResolveInflightOperation, evaluateSubscriptionSearchResult, validateWebhookRequiredEnvVars. While some are trivial (e.g., isSubscriptionCreatedEvent is a single string comparison), others like shouldSyncRole (used in REQ-SYNC-010 to decide when role sync triggers) and isStatusUnknown (used in REQ-SYNC-011 for safe-side revocation) guard critical behavioral boundaries. The Sprint 1 contract dimension 'Purity Compliance' (line 201) requires 'All pure functions tested without mocks; property tests for all boundary conditions' — the current coverage does not satisfy this.
recommendation: Add PROP-SYNC entries for at minimum shouldSyncRole, isStatusUnknown, canResolveInflightOperation, and evaluateSubscriptionSearchResult. These four guard safety-critical decisions (role sync trigger, safe-side revocation, inflight resolution, subscription search evaluation).
